# Browser collector fixtures

Synthetic inputs for the v2 Claude browser collector tests (`tests/browser-collector.test.ts`,
`tests/browser-collector.integration.test.ts`). Each file carries its own `_fixture` declaration
(origin, ref, completeness, excerpt-or-raw) as `CONTRIBUTING.md` requires. No real account, organization,
email, or credential appears; the text `PRIVATE SENTINEL` marks fields that must never reach an upload.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `claude-web-usage.json` | A claude.ai organization usage response in every shape `browser/claude-quota/normalize.js` recognizes: the `limits` array (session, pooled weekly, one model-scoped weekly window, one unknown kind), the legacy top-level windows, enabled extra-usage credits, and decoy organization, email, and token fields. |

This directory is separate from `tests/fixtures/usage-v2/`, whose manifest is generated by the
companion's fixture script and must not list hand-written files.
